name: Custodians

subjectOf.text: Custodial service providers spend proportionally less on IT security than non custodial ones: custodians spend between 6 and 10 percent of resources on IT security while non custodial service providers spend between 11 and 20 percent.
subjectOf.abstract: Notably, custodians spend between 6% to 10% of their resources on IT security while non-custodial service providers spend between 11% to 20% of its resources, both financial and human, on IT security.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
scope_conditions: surveyed cryptoasset service providers in the 2020 benchmarking study

subjectOf.text: Externally led auditing of digital asset reserves among custodial service providers is declining, falling 24 percentage points relative to the 2018 sample.
subjectOf.abstract: The report noted this is a 24-percentage point decline compared to their 2018 sample.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
scope_conditions: surveyed custodial service providers, 2020 benchmarking study

subjectOf.text: Insurance coverage among digital asset service providers is far from universal: 46 percent of surveyed service providers reported not being insured against any risks.
